args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing
deeply nested arrays. Affected: <2.9.4; fixed in 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
- Stays on the 2.x line; 2.9.4 is the first fixed version per the advisory.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` (sha `c8b8ab7878`): **passed**

## Approval
- Requires code-owner approval to merge into main. Reviewer requested: @alex
